factoryContract.method: make(maximumCodecOwnedByteCharge: Int, limits: DecodeLimits) throws -> any ProgressiveImagePackedRGB8FinalizingSession

obligations.summary: The public tight RGB8 value is externally constructible, exact, alpha-free, and rejects an invalid byte count.
Arbitrary source chunks publish no preview in the final-only profile and finalization preflight is nil until complete and non-consuming once ready.
The final-ready resource ledger is exact, bounded, caller-source composable, and publishes codec-owned RGB8 output authority.
Finalization binds the complete source byte count and transfers the frozen exact 23x13 tight RGB8 value with no synthesized alpha.
Whole-input, bytewise, and uneven arbitrary-chunk schedules produce the identical packed RGB8 final value.
Encoded-byte/format hard limits and an ICC-bearing JFIF source fail closed without publishing a packed final value.
Cancellation is idempotent and fences append, preflight, and packed finalization using the public progressive-session cancellation contract.
The hard codec-owned operation budget is enforced before a session with insufficient minimum retained state can be created.
